boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Hofstra University
boards.description: Verified late-hour food destinations on campus and in Hempstead-area communities, with current hours cited for each stop.

cards.title: Hof USA
cards.subtitle: Hofstra University, Hempstead
cards.notes: Use the on-campus option when you need food after an evening commitment; confirm service details before heading over.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus dining destination with service listed until 3 a.m. every day.
cards.evidence_claim: Hofstra Dining Services states that Hof USA offers late-night dining from 6 p.m. to 3 a.m., seven days a week.
cards.access_notes: Hofstra lists late-night dining daily, 6 p.m.-3 a.m. Check the dining site for operational updates.

cards.title: Campus Pizza Gyro
cards.subtitle: 742 Fulton Ave, Hempstead
cards.notes: Plan a pickup order for the Fulton Avenue location and allow time to travel; its site lists the same late closing time daily.
cards.short_summary: A Hempstead pizza-and-gyro stop listing service until 2 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Campus Pizza Gyro lists its hours as noon to 2 a.m., Monday through Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Business site lists daily hours of noon-2 a.m.; verify availability before departing.

cards.title: Kennedy Chicken Grill Kabab & Gyro
cards.subtitle: 57 S Franklin St, Hempstead
cards.notes: For a later pickup, use the restaurant’s ordering link and check the day-specific carryout cutoff before you leave.
cards.short_summary: A South Franklin Street restaurant with late evening hours every day.
cards.evidence_claim: Kennedy Chicken Grill Kabab & Gyro lists restaurant hours until 2 a.m. Sunday-Thursday and 3 a.m. Friday-Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant hours run to 2 a.m. most nights and 3 a.m. Friday-Saturday; carryout hours end earlier.

cards.title: Tres Sabores
cards.subtitle: 77 Main St, Hempstead
cards.notes: Check the day of your visit, then place a pickup or delivery order through the restaurant’s own ordering page.
cards.short_summary: A Main Street Honduran restaurant whose listed closing time varies by day.
cards.evidence_claim: Tres Sabores lists hours until 1 a.m. on selected weekdays and until 3 a.m. on Friday, Saturday, and Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Listed hours: 1 a.m. on Monday, Wednesday, and Thursday; 3 a.m. Friday, Saturday, and Sunday. Closed Tuesday.

cards.title: Halal Munchies Hempstead
cards.subtitle: 453 Hempstead Turnpike, West Hempstead
cards.notes: Use the business’s online ordering page to confirm the location and place an order before making the trip.
cards.short_summary: A West Hempstead halal restaurant listing a 3 a.m. close every day.
cards.evidence_claim: Halal Munchies lists restaurant hours of 11 a.m. to 3 a.m. Monday through Sunday at its Hempstead location.
cards.access_notes: The restaurant’s location page lists 11 a.m.-3 a.m. daily; confirm service method before travel.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Peninsula Boulevard
cards.subtitle: 490 Peninsula Blvd, Hempstead
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru for the latest listed service and check the official location page for the day’s current operating status.
cards.short_summary: A Hempstead Taco Bell whose drive-thru is listed until 4 a.m. most days.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists drive-thru hours until 4 a.m. Sunday through Friday and 24 hours on Saturday at 490 Peninsula Boulevard.
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru: until 4 a.m. Sunday-Friday and open 24 hours Saturday. Listed dine-in hours end earlier.

cards.title: Wingstop on Front Street
cards.subtitle: 5 Front St, Hempstead
cards.notes: Check the location page for today’s close, then order directly for pickup or delivery if its late-hours window fits.
cards.short_summary: A Front Street Wingstop whose official locator lists a 2 a.m. closing time.
cards.evidence_claim: Wingstop’s Hempstead locator lists its 5 Front Street restaurant as closing at 2 a.m.
cards.access_notes: Official locator lists 5 Front Street and a 2 a.m. close; verify the live location status before leaving.

cards.title: McDonald's on Peninsula Boulevard
cards.subtitle: 340 Peninsula Blvd, Hempstead
cards.notes: Use the official location page to confirm which service is available; the lobby and drive-thru have different listed hours.
cards.short_summary: A Peninsula Boulevard McDonald's with a 24-hour drive-thru listing.
cards.evidence_claim: McDonald's lists the 340 Peninsula Boulevard drive-thru as open 24 hours daily; its restaurant lobby is listed until midnight.
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru is listed 24 hours daily; lobby hours are 6 a.m.-midnight. Confirm live availability in the official locator.

cards.title: Pizza Hut on Fulton Avenue
cards.subtitle: 760 Fulton Ave, Hempstead
cards.notes: Order through Pizza Hut’s location page for delivery or carryout, and recheck the restaurant’s status before setting out.
cards.short_summary: A Fulton Avenue Pizza Hut listing delivery and carryout until 2 a.m. daily.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizza Hut lists delivery and carryout hours of 10 a.m. to 2 a.m. daily at 760 Fulton Avenue in Hempstead.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists delivery and carryout from 10 a.m. until 2 a.m. every day.

cards.title: Wendy's on Hempstead Turnpike
cards.subtitle: 65 Hempstead Tpke, West Hempstead
cards.notes: Review the location’s day-specific hours before leaving, especially if you are relying on the later Friday or Saturday close.
cards.short_summary: A West Hempstead Wendy's listing service until 2 a.m. most nights and 3 a.m. on weekends.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy's lists restaurant and drive-thru hours until 2 a.m. Sunday-Thursday and 3 a.m. Friday-Saturday at 65 Hempstead Turnpike.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant and drive-thru are listed until 2 a.m. Sunday-Thursday and 3 a.m. Friday-Saturday.
